title: Team Mock Assessment
subject: Core Engineering & Navigation
description: Timed assessment with anti-cheat protection and per-candidate question randomization.
instructions: Tab switching, external AI usage, or losing window focus results in immediate disqualification and blocking.
Questions are uniquely allocated per candidate.

questions.questionText: Which is NOT a weakness of a compass?
options: It is affected by nearby iron
It stops working without satellite signal
questions.explanation: A magnetic compass operates purely via Earth's magnetic field and does not rely on satellite signals.

questions.questionText: Which method of finding own position is used when no feature is common to both the map and the ground?
questions.explanation: Resection method determines one's own position by drawing back-azimuth lines from two or more visible distant points.

questions.questionText: Which is true of the Equal Altitude method of finding north?
options: It is quick and works in cloud
It is accurate but slow and needs sunlight
questions.explanation: The Equal Altitude method utilizes the sun's shadow before and after noon; it is highly accurate but requires clear sunlight and time.
